title: k8s-marathon PaaS Controller variables
description: Configuration variables for the Kubernetes Marathon-Equivalent PaaS Controller

K8S_MARATHON_VERSION.description: Specific version of the k8s-marathon controller to install.

K8S_MARATHON_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install k8s-marathon ('libscript_native' isolates binaries in LIBSCRIPT_HOME, 'system' uses OS packages).

K8S_MARATHON_PORT.description: TCP port on which the k8s-marathon PaaS REST API listens.

K8S_MARATHON_NAMESPACE.description: Default Kubernetes namespace for reconciled Deployments, StatefulSets, Jobs, Services, and Ingresses.

K8S_MARATHON_KUBECONFIG.description: Filesystem path to the kubeconfig file used to communicate with the Kubernetes API server.

K8S_MARATHON_HOME.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for k8s-marathon (K8S_MARATHON_HOME).

K8S_MARATHON_STATE_DIR.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for k8s-marathon (K8S_MARATHON_STATE_DIR).
